prompt: Explain how this app is structured: the entry point, the main modules, and how data flows from the external APIs to the UI. Cite file paths with line numbers. Keep the answer under 200 words.
List every function exported from src/lib/cache.ts and, for each one, every file that calls it, with file:line for each call site. Be complete; do not guess.

In src/lib/api-clients, make every fetch() call use a 10-second timeout by passing signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) in its options (add an options object where there is none, and keep existing options). Skip calls that already pass a signal. Make the edits directly; don't run any build or test commands. Reply with one line saying how many calls you changed.
check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),d='src/lib/api-clients';let bad=[];for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const s=fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+f,'utf8');const n=(s.match(/\bfetch\(/g)||[]).length,t=(s.match(/signal:/g)||[]).length;if(t<n)bad.push(f+' '+t+'/'+n)}if(bad.length){console.log('missing: '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"

prompt: Run the test suite with `npm test`. One test fails. Find and fix the bug in the source code (do not change any tests), then run `npm test` again to confirm everything passes. Reply with one line describing the fix.
check: npm test >/dev/null 2>&1 && git diff --quiet HEAD -- test/

prompt: Answer from the files in data/: (1) How many orders in data/orders.json have status "refunded"? (2) Which error code appears most often in data/server.log, and how many times? Reply with just the two answers.
Explain step by step what computeTotals in src/engine.js does, including what each helper it calls does (shipping, tax, discount, rules). Cite line numbers.
Find where formatCurrency is defined and every place in the source code that calls it. Give file:line for each.

Make these changes one at a time, running `npm test` after each and fixing anything that breaks before moving on: (1) one test currently fails; fix the bug in src/ that causes it, without changing tests; (2) add an optional second parameter `currency` to formatCurrency in src/money.js, default "USD"; "EUR" uses a € prefix instead of $; (3) make buildReport in src/report.js pass each order's `currency` field to formatCurrency (the TOTAL line stays USD); (4) add a test for EUR formatting to test/money.test.js. Reply with one line when everything passes.
check: npm test >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -q EUR test/money.test.js && grep -q currency src/report.js && git diff --quiet HEAD -- test/engine.test.js test/report.test.js

prompt: Create test/rules-threshold.test.js in the style of test/engine.test.js. For every ruleNNN function exported from src/engine.js (there are 160) write one explicit test() call, with no loops or generated tests. Title each test exactly `ruleNNN needs N items and $T`, where N is that rule's minimum item count and T its subtotal threshold as written in the source. Each test asserts that the rule returns 0 for an order with a single item priced one dollar under T (qty 1, no tags), with the price written as a literal number. Do not run anything. Reply with one line.
check: node --test test/rules-threshold.test.js >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo tests fail; exit 1; }; node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),s=fs.readFileSync("src/engine.js","utf8"),t=fs.readFileSync("test/rules-threshold.test.js","utf8");let n=0,bad=[];for(const m of s.matchAll(/export function (rule\d+)\(order\) \{[^]*?length < (\d+)\)[^]*?subtotal < (\d+)\)/g)){n++;if(!t.includes(m[1]+" needs "+m[2]+" items and $"+m[3]+"\""))bad.push(m[1])}if(n!==160||bad.length){console.log("wrong or missing: "+bad.length+" of "+n);process.exit(1)}'

prompt: Two questions about src/engine.js. (1) Among the rules that credit items tagged "gift", which rule gives the highest credit per tagged item, and how much is it? (2) What does shipping cost for a UK order below the free-shipping threshold that contains a bulk item? Reply with just the two answers.

In src/money.js, make formatCurrency render negative amounts in parentheses, so -3 becomes ($3.00) instead of -$3.00, and update the one test in test/money.test.js that covers negatives. Change nothing else and do not run anything. Reply with one line.
check: node --test --test-name-pattern=negatives test/money.test.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -qF '($3.00)' test/money.test.js && git diff --quiet HEAD -- src/engine.js test/engine.test.js
